result.topic_en: A table of primes of the form 8n+5 (5, 13, 29, 37, 53, 61, 101, 109), listing for each the classes (Cl.) of quadratic forms or residues, the representation of the class as a sum of squares, and the numbers each class contains.

methods.what: Primes p ≡ 5 (mod 8) expressed as a sum of two squares (class 0)
For p=5, the classes coincide with quadratic residues and non-residues: class 0 contains all 4n+1 (residues), class 1 all 4n−1 (non-residues)
methods.quote:
Cl. 0. $4+1$ continet omnes $4n+1$ {+Res.+}
Cl. 1. continet omnes $4n-1$ N.R.

methods.what: Paired classes represented as sums of three squares, with small primes contained in them
Statement that primes marked 0,2 (13, 37) behave like 5
methods.quote: De hoc et sequenti (37) qui 0,2 {+est+} sunt signati, idem tenendum quod de 5

items.quote: De hoc et sequenti (37) qui 0,2 {+est+} sunt signati, idem tenendum quod de 5
items.english: Of this one and the following (37), which are marked 0,2, the same is to be held as of 5.
